definition: Asked at the start of an online call to check the audio.
exampleSentence: The first thing people say on a video call is "Can you hear me?"

definition: Tells someone that their microphone is turned off.
exampleSentence: Sorry, you're on mute, so we could not hear your question.

definition: Said before showing your screen to others in a meeting.
exampleSentence: Let me share my screen so you can see the new design.

definition: Politely asks someone to say something again.
exampleSentence: Sorry, the connection was bad, could you repeat that last part?

definition: Means you will discuss a topic later with fewer people.
exampleSentence: That is a detailed question, so I'll take that offline with Ali.

definition: Asked to check that others see what you are sharing.
exampleSentence: Before the demo, she asked, "Can you see my screen?"

definition: Tells someone their audio or video is cutting in and out.
exampleSentence: Sorry, you're breaking up, maybe your internet is slow.

definition: A polite apology when you join a meeting late.
exampleSentence: Sorry I'm late, my previous meeting ran over.

definition: Said to begin a meeting.
exampleSentence: Everyone is here, so let's get started with the first topic.

definition: Introduces a short question.
exampleSentence: I have a quick question about the budget before we finish.

definition: Asks the audience if they have questions.
exampleSentence: At the end of the presentation, she asked if there were any questions.

turkish: kesin çıkmam gereken bir saat var
definition: Means you must leave the meeting at an exact time.
exampleSentence: Just so you know, I have a hard stop at eleven o'clock.

definition: Means you will send more details by email after the meeting.
exampleSentence: I do not have the numbers now, but I'll follow up by email.

definition: Checks that others understand what you said.
exampleSentence: I explained the new process and asked, "Does that make sense?"

definition: Used to add a point to what someone just said.
exampleSentence: To add to that, the new tool is also much cheaper.

definition: Asks to return to an earlier topic or slide.
exampleSentence: Sorry, can we go back to the previous slide for a moment?

definition: Says you did not hear or understand something.
exampleSentence: Sorry, I didn't catch that, could you say it again?

turkish: biraz daha yüksek sesle konuşur musunuz
definition: Politely asks someone to speak louder.
exampleSentence: The sound is very quiet, could you speak up a little?

definition: A polite way to start speaking while someone else is talking.
exampleSentence: Sorry to interrupt, but we only have five minutes left.

definition: Gives someone permission to speak or continue.
exampleSentence: We both started talking at once, so I said, "Go ahead."

definition: Shows you understand someone's opinion, even if you do not fully agree.
exampleSentence: I see your point, but the budget is still a problem.

definition: A polite way to disagree.
exampleSentence: I'm not sure I agree, because the users never asked for this feature.

definition: Means to stop discussing a topic for now and return to it later.
exampleSentence: That is a big topic, so let's park that until next week.

definition: Says the meeting will end soon.
exampleSentence: We're running out of time, so let us focus on the main decision.

definition: Suggests another meeting to continue a topic.
exampleSentence: We could not finish, so let's schedule a follow-up for Thursday.

definition: Asks who will write down the meeting notes.
exampleSentence: Before we begin the meeting, who's taking notes today?

definition: Checks that all participants can see what is shared.
exampleSentence: She shared the chart and asked, "Can everyone see this?"

definition: Promises to share the video of the meeting.
exampleSentence: If you missed anything, I'll send the recording after the call.

definition: The actions planned after a meeting.
exampleSentence: Before we finish, let us agree on the next steps.

definition: To join a meeting by phone.
exampleSentence: You can dial in from your phone if your internet is slow.

definition: To enter an online or in-person meeting.
exampleSentence: Click the link in the invitation to join the meeting.

definition: To turn off your own microphone.
exampleSentence: Please mute yourself when you are not speaking.

definition: To start your video so others can see you.
exampleSentence: Could you turn on your camera for the team photo?

definition: To use the hand button to ask to speak in an online meeting.
exampleSentence: If you have a question, please raise your hand in the app.

definition: Agrees that someone's comment is useful or true.
exampleSentence: That's a good point, I had not thought about mobile users.

definition: Says you will find the answer before replying.
exampleSentence: I am not sure about the price, so let me check with finance.

definition: Used to state something clearly so it is remembered.
exampleSentence: For the record, I warned the team about this risk last month.

definition: Introduces a short summary of what was discussed.
exampleSentence: Just to recap, Ali will fix the bug and Sara will test it.

definition: Gives the next speaker their turn.
exampleSentence: That is all from me, so over to you, Maria.

definition: A friendly way to end a meeting.
exampleSentence: Thanks everyone, see you all at the same time next week.
